marketLayer.title: HK Tech Giants & AI Commercialization
marketLayer.fact: Hang Seng Tech Index heavyweights saw heightened institutional inflows following updates on enterprise AI integrations and accelerating cloud sector revenues.
marketLayer.inference: Market focus in the Chinese tech space is transitioning from initial capital expenditure capacity building to demonstrable revenue contribution from AI products.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Macroeconomic consumption recovery pace in mainland China and ongoing international tech supply chain constraints.

marketLayer.title: US Fed Rate Outlook & Global Capital Flows
marketLayer.fact: US stock futures and Treasury yields remained bound within a narrow range during Asian trading hours as investors analyzed recent macroeconomic inflation data.
marketLayer.inference: A prolonged higher-for-longer interest rate regime continues to favor cash-rich mega-cap technology firms while pressuring small-cap equity valuations.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Stickiness of core services inflation and potential shifts in FOMC monetary easing timing.

marketLayer.title: HK/US Dual-Listed EV Sector Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: Major electric vehicle manufacturers posted mixed share performance following the release of monthly delivery guidance and expanded overseas market penetration strategy updates.
marketLayer.inference: While overseas expansion offers new volume drivers, persistent domestic price wars continue to weigh on short-term corporate gross profit margins.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Final decisions on foreign anti-subsidy tariffs and geopolitical trade policy shifts.
